docsPromises.promise: A verification-intent author can save a valid planned producer→consumer declaration during PLAN; invalid, ordinary-caller, and post-PLAN writes are rejected without changing the saved declaration.

The terminal prints `Topology state: legacy_missing` for an old contract, or `Result: inconclusive_basis_unverified` plus stable `AT_*` diagnostics for a configured contract; it never prints `complete` or `ready-for-review`.
`lattice acceptance_matrix --storyId=<id>` prints deterministic canonical rows and legacy/warning/inconclusive diagnostics, explicitly marked observe, read-only, and non-evidentiary.
The focused test exits 0 and prints `ProofStory acceptance topology Wave 1 smoke passed`; lifecycle phase/guard equality, read-only bytes, and no-Wave-1A assertions are all included in that pass.
